reference: About 200 models across 20+ disciplines; a Navisworks federation of 100-115 models per weekly cycle; ~3,000 TIDP/MIDP deliverables per MIDP issue; 50 add-in users (team size not confirmed).

rows.fn: Dashboard: Run Analysis (missing code and zone by category)
rows.basis: Counting elements with a blank Clash Code or Zone, category by category, with schedules and filters.

rows.fn: Parameter Coverage and missing-parameter CSV
rows.basis: Finding which categories the parameter is not bound to, one category at a time, and listing them for the parameter owner.

rows.fn: Assign Values (by category, selection or preview rows)
rows.basis: Selecting elements category by category and typing the value into Properties.

rows.fn: Auto-Map Clash Code from the clash matrix
rows.basis: Looking up each category's code in the clash matrix and entering it by hand.

rows.fn: Import / Export values through CSV or Excel
rows.basis: Editing values in schedules or exporting by hand and re-keying them.

rows.fn: Export Template from a shared parameter file
rows.basis: Typing each shared-parameter definition into a spreadsheet.

rows.fn: Preview (will add, will extend, already bound)
rows.basis: Checking which parameters already exist and which categories are missing, parameter by parameter.

rows.fn: Apply Checked (Type or Instance, group, categories)
rows.basis: Manage > Project Parameters: add each parameter, pick its group, tick its categories (~2 min each, 30-60 parameters).

rows.fn: Collect Warnings and the model-health dashboard
rows.basis: Opening Review Warnings and scrolling a long, ungrouped list with no counts.

rows.fn: Filter and search (category, severity, fix-by, text)
rows.basis: Reading the list to find which warnings belong together.

rows.fn: Resolve Duplicates (Number, Mark, Type Mark)
rows.basis: Renumbering duplicate marks and numbers one by one.

rows.fn: Resolve Joins
rows.basis: Unjoining and re-joining element pairs one at a time with the right priority.

rows.fn: Resolve Overlaps (wall/wall, floor/floor, wall and room line)
rows.basis: Cutting geometry or shortening room lines one overlap at a time.

rows.fn: Repair Sketches (off-axis lines)
rows.basis: Opening each sketch and straightening lines so the loop stays closed.

rows.fn: Repair Constraints, Clean Up Rooms, Correct Alignment
rows.basis: Fixing constraint, room and slightly-off-axis wall warnings individually.

rows.fn: Review One by One (show in 3D, fix this one)
rows.basis: Selecting each element pair, isolating it in 3D and fixing it by hand.

rows.fn: Export CSV, Excel, JSON and summary
rows.basis: Copying the warnings list into Excel for the BIM report.

rows.fn: Write rules (category, family, type to workset)
rows.basis: Planning workset assignment and noting it down before selecting by category.

rows.fn: Save / Load Config (share rules between models)
rows.basis: Re-creating the same selection logic in each model.

rows.fn: Preview (will move, already correct, in groups, owned by others)
rows.basis: Selecting category by category and checking each element's current workset.

rows.fn: Apply Checked (one transaction, creates missing worksets)
rows.basis: Selecting elements and using the workset drop-down repeatedly; creating worksets by hand.

rows.fn: Filter by name and status; Check All / Uncheck All
rows.basis: Scrolling Manage Links and picking rows one at a time.

rows.fn: Tick Revit Selection
rows.basis: Selecting link instances and finding them in Manage Links.

rows.fn: Load Checked / Unload Checked (many links)
rows.basis: Right-click each link in Manage Links: Unload or Reload.

rows.fn: Unload for me (workshared models)
rows.basis: Using Unload for me per link.

rows.fn: Choose disciplines and tests (143 tests in 5 disciplines)
rows.basis: Working out which checklist items apply to this model.

rows.fn: Test Settings (naming, worksets, levels, angles)
rows.basis: Documenting the project standard so tests have something to compare against.

rows.fn: Run Health Check (automated and config-compared tests)
rows.basis: Manually inspecting links, grids and levels, worksets, views and templates against the checklist.

rows.fn: Review Fail and Needs review rows
rows.basis: Reading findings and recording what to fix.

rows.fn: Export Excel report
rows.basis: Writing the findings up in a report.

rows.fn: Validate and preview from an Excel mapping workbook
rows.basis: Matching category, family, type and scope to values by hand.

rows.fn: Apply values and formula-built asset codes
rows.basis: Typing Type and Instance parameter values and building codes such as AST-L01-Door-001 by hand.

rows.fn: Read-back verification and QA/QC report
rows.basis: Re-opening elements to confirm values, then reporting.

rows.fn: Filter tests by name; Select All
rows.basis: Scrolling the Clash Detective test list to find the tests to change.

rows.fn: Apply to Selected (one tolerance to many tests)
rows.basis: Opening each test's properties and typing the tolerance (~30 s each across ~100 tests).

rows.fn: Test summary grid (New, Active, Reviewed, Approved, Resolved)
rows.basis: Opening each test in Clash Detective to read its counts.

rows.fn: Filtered results grid across all tests
rows.basis: Browsing results test by test and filtering by status, distance and approver.

rows.fn: Approve / Resolve Selected (records who and when)
rows.basis: Selecting results and approving them one by one, recording who and when by hand.

rows.fn: Comments: add, edit, delete
rows.basis: Typing comments result by result in the native panel.

rows.fn: Load Asset Info (Element ID, family, type, workset, file)
rows.basis: Selecting each clashing item and reading its properties.

rows.fn: Export CSV / Import CSV (review round trip)
rows.basis: Writing results out and re-keying decisions made elsewhere.

rows.fn: Run Analysis: dashboard tiles (status and severity)
rows.basis: Counting results per test and status in Clash Detective and Excel.

rows.fn: Tile filters and Clash Tests table with CSV / Excel export
rows.basis: Filtering and exporting per-test summaries.

rows.fn: Categories & Matrix: category mapping and matrix validation
rows.basis: Checking the clash matrix against the test list by hand.

rows.fn: Trend chart across past runs
rows.basis: Keeping run-by-run history in a spreadsheet.

rows.fn: Detailed Clash Export (open clashes by zone, file, asset)
rows.basis: Compiling element-level clash lists by zone, source file and asset.

rows.fn: Set required parameters and file scope
rows.basis: Listing what must be present and in which files.

rows.fn: Run Parameter Check (all elements in 100-115 files)
rows.basis: Opening files and checking schedules or properties for gaps.

rows.fn: Dashboard (files scanned, elements missing, by file)
rows.basis: Compiling gaps by file.

rows.fn: Export CSV / Excel; double-click to isolate in 3D
rows.basis: Writing up missing elements and locating each one.

rows.fn: List viewpoints with comment counts and last comment
rows.basis: Stepping through Saved Viewpoints one at a time.

rows.fn: Add, edit and delete comments
rows.basis: Using the native panel per viewpoint.

rows.fn: Export comments (CSV / Excel)
rows.basis: Copying comments out one by one.

rows.fn: Export Viewpoints (XML: camera, clipping, comments)
rows.basis: Exporting and archiving viewpoint definitions by hand.

rows.fn: Export Viewpoints Report (HTML with a screenshot each)
rows.basis: Capturing and captioning a screenshot per viewpoint.

rows.fn: Filter, select categories, Hide Selected / Show Selected
rows.basis: Building a search or selection per category and hiding it.

rows.fn: Hide All / Show All
rows.basis: Resetting visibility category by category.

rows.fn: Load the schedule and map the columns
rows.basis: Preparing the MIDP rows, finding the identifier, format and revision columns, filtering to filled rows across many tabs.

rows.fn: Build the Files Log
rows.basis: Exporting or scanning the shared ACC folders of 20+ disciplines into a list, scoped to files that reached Shared.

rows.fn: Match every deliverable and format
rows.basis: ~3,000 deliverables by hand, including naming drift (extra suffixes, revision tags, casing).

rows.fn: Compile the QA/QC report
rows.basis: Listing missing, partial, duplicate and extra files and saving the report back to ACC.

rows.fn: Open the model and wait for it to load
rows.basis: Open in desktop Revit, sync, wait. The batch app opens models in the cloud.

rows.fn: Run the checks
rows.basis: Run the QA checklist in Revit and wait for it to finish.

rows.fn: Export and format the report
rows.basis: Export the results and tidy them into a report.

rows.fn: Save to ACC and keep track
rows.basis: Upload the report to the right folder and tick the model off a list. The app saves each report as the model finishes.

rows.fn: Set up the batch once, then review
rows.basis: Ruleset, models and save folder chosen once; results reviewed per model.

rows.fn: Overview
rows.basis: Pulling headline KPIs, a ranked 'what to chase first' list and a project table together from every other report.

rows.fn: Issue tracking and Issue Status Dashboard
rows.basis: Exporting ACC issues, then pivoting by trade, asset, company, age and type, and building a one-page status per building or zone.

rows.fn: Model sharing (incl. NWC and NWD files)
rows.basis: Walking each trade's ACC folders for ~200 models, checking versions and dates against the required list, flagging naming-rule breaks and stale files.

rows.fn: Model performance
rows.basis: Opening and rolling up health reports across ~200 models into scores by discipline, failing checks and trends.

rows.fn: TIDP/MIDP progress
rows.basis: Reading the Checker's reports across packages and rolling completion up by trade and package.

rows.fn: Missing clash parameters
rows.basis: Combining parameter-check reports across a 100-115 model federation, comparing runs, and splitting by trade, parameter and file.

rows.fn: Viewpoints report
rows.basis: Comparing viewpoint snapshots, tracking what is new, fixed or closed, and checking cross-verification.

rows.fn: Clash report
rows.basis: Building status and severity trends, the trade-against-trade matrix and package roll-ups from Clash Analyser exports.

rows.fn: Exports and the full BIM QA/QC report
rows.basis: Formatting an Excel or PDF pack with cover page and every board, each cycle.

rows.fn: Send the installer and instructions
rows.basis: Distributing the installer and what to do.

rows.fn: Run the installer on each PC
rows.basis: 5-8 min per PC including closing Revit or Navisworks.

rows.fn: Chase and support problem PCs
rows.basis: Failed installs, wrong versions, people who missed the email.

rows.fn: Check who has what
rows.basis: Confirming versions and access per person; Devices and People pages do this automatically.

rows.fn: Publish the release and check Devices
rows.basis: Upload the build, release it, glance at the Devices page.
